Local Gemma model

Gemma 4 E2B-it runs entirely inside Tapziq through LiteRT-LM. The verified model is downloaded only when you ask, kept in app-private storage, and works offline for proofreading and autocorrect after installation. The download is 2.59 GB and requires roughly 3 GB of free space.

Download the local AI model?
Tapziq will download the pinned 2.59 GB Gemma 4 E2B-it model from Hugging Face, verify its SHA-256 checksum, and keep it in app-private storage. Wi-Fi is recommended.
Remove Gemma 4 E2B-it?
Tapziq will delete the verified model or any partial download, including any legacy runtime cache. Proofreading and Gemma autocorrect will stop working until you download and verify the model again.

Offline translation

Tapziq works with David Ventura’s separately installed Offline Translator app. Install it, open it once, and download the language packs you want. Then highlight text in any compatible field, tap Translate above the keyboard, choose the languages in Offline Translator, and return the result to Tapziq for review before Apply. Offline Translator’s current Process Text diagnostics may write the returned translation to Android’s diagnostic log; Tapziq does not log it.

Gemma autocorrect

Off by default. When enabled, Tapziq sends recently completed text only to the local Gemma model after you pause. A correction is applied only if the field and cursor are still exactly unchanged. Model loading can take time; Backspace immediately after a correction restores the original text.

Optional and off by default. When enabled, dismissing a one-word Gemma review or undoing an autocorrection remembers only the exact written and rejected words. In a compatible editor, tapping a recent corrected word shows Tapziq’s original-word candidate; using it reverses and rejects the correction, while dismissing it or tapping away records the rejection. If you replace that same word with Tapziq, it learns the replacement when you type a boundary or move away. Recent tap matching can start a review for up to two minutes in the current editor; once opened, that review and replacement tracking expire after 30 seconds without related activity. No sentence, app name, or typing history is saved.

Clear learned corrections?
This deletes Tapziq’s app-private word correction memory. The Gemma model and autocorrect setting will not change.
Tapziq could not durably clear the learned corrections. Try again.
Private by design

Typed text stays on your device. For proofreading and enabled autocorrect, Tapziq briefly reads up to 2,000 characters so it can validate the editor; only the requested or recently completed passage (up to 500 characters) is processed by Tapziq’s app-private Gemma model. For translation, only text you explicitly highlight is handed in memory to the separately installed Offline Translator app, whose language packs, processing, storage, and diagnostics are controlled by that app. Its current Process Text diagnostics may write the returned translation to Android’s diagnostic log; Tapziq does not log it. Tapziq receives the chosen result in memory and changes the field only after Apply. Tapziq does not save passages or general typing history, read the clipboard, show ads, run analytics, or put editor text in its own network requests. Optional correction learning can save up to 100 exact word-level preferences in app-private, no-backup storage. Tapziq’s own network access is used only for an explicit Gemma model download.
Android shows a standard warning when any downloaded keyboard is enabled. Tapziq cannot enable or select itself; those choices stay under your control.
